releaseNotes: Generate animated ponds, rivers, streams, waterfalls, and shorelines in the web editor and desktop app, with top-down or isometric views.
Keep shorelines fixed while tuning water animation. Use seasonal palettes, frozen pond edges, live preview, and a 3× repeat check.
Draw with isometric guides and snapping, or stamp editable tiles, raised blocks, and ramps.
New water and isometric guides include reproducible commands and downloadable editable projects for people and agents.
Water animations loop in time; automatic seamless connections between terrain tiles are not included.
In PixelWall 0.3.2 or later, choose Check for Updates, download, then Restart to update. Your artwork is saved first.
